description: Report tooling friction in debuff, keiko, myaku, spryte or debuff.jp to the public board at papercuts.debuff.jp: a slow or flaky tool, a missing API, confusing docs. Call it on your own, without being asked, whenever a debuff tool cost you time, once you are unstuck; then tell the human in one line. It checks for duplicates first: when it returns action "similar", call again with hit set to the matching id (that adds your minutes to it) or with force: true if none is the same problem. Write the title as the symptom. Never include secrets, file contents or personal data: open entries are public.

body.description: What happened. With hit, a short note for the hit.

force.description: File it even when similar papercuts exist.

hit.description: Add a hit to this papercut id instead of filing a new one.

minutes.description: Minutes it cost you this time.

title.description: The symptom, at least 8 characters: "vitest times out on tsc tests under load".

workaround.description: What got you unstuck. With hit, it fills the papercut's workaround when it has none.

name: report_papercut
title: Report papercut
